verdict.rationale: VPM advertises a "Real U.S. street address" (docs-34). Its TruLease product adds a commercial office address backed by a lease agreement and utility service, aimed at compliance for financial accounts and address verification (docs-14, docs-31, docs-32). The included registered-agent service and LLC formation guidance support LLC registration (docs-11, docs-12). The main caveat is that VPM itself says the basic virtual mailbox address does not work for opening bank accounts, so bank KYC needs the higher TruLease/TruResidence tier (docs-33). Missing for 10: KYC-grade address in the base mailbox plan, explicit evidence of acceptance on vendor forms, and independent or hands-on confirmation of bank/state acceptance.
